title: Pure Heraldic Beast
summary: Heraldic Beast is Vetrix's psychic Rank 4 Xyz archetype that weaponizes name manipulation and graveyard recursion to overwhelm opponent boards. Modern starters Heraldic Beast Gryphon and Stad Whale rapidly fetch Advanced Heraldry Art and Flash of Heraldry, easily fulfilling 3-material requirements to summon Number 69: Heraldry Crest. From there, the deck ranks up into Number 69: Heraldry Crest - Shatter Stream and the indestructible boss Dark Matter Demolition, turning opposing monsters into 'Unknown' cards with permanently negated effects.

allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Heraldic Beast Leo to the GY to immediately trigger its mandatory search for any Heraldic Beast monster.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Augmented Heraldry.

main: Heraldic Beast Gryphon

Core starter: sends 1 Heraldic Beast (Leo!) from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself from hand, and counts as 2 materials for the Xyz Summon of a 3+ material 'Number' Xyz Monster (making 3-material Number 69 with just 2 monsters!).
Heraldic Beast Stad Whale

Core starter: discards 1 card when Normal or Special Summoned to add ANY 2 'Heraldry' Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand, and banishes itself from the GY to summon 2 same-name Heraldic Beasts from GY in Defense Position!
Heraldic Beast Leo
Core searcher: mandatory trigger when sent to the GY (by Gryphon, Number 18, or Xyz detach) to add 1 'Heraldic Beast' monster (except Leo) from your Deck to your hand.
Heraldic Beast Amphisbaena
Discards 1 other Heraldic Beast monster to Special Summon itself from your hand.
Heraldic Beast Aberconway
Banishes another Heraldic Beast Aberconway from your GY to add 1 Heraldic Beast monster from your GY to your hand, and provides an 1800 ATK body for Stad Whale's revival.
Heraldic Beast Unicorn
Banishes itself from your GY to target 1 Psychic Xyz Monster (Number 18 or any Number 69 form!) in your GY and Special Summon it.
Heraldic Beast Twin-Headed Eagle
Banishes itself from your GY to target 1 face-up Xyz Monster you control with no materials and attach 2 Heraldic Beast monsters from your GY to it as materials.
Advanced Heraldry Art
Signature Spell: targets 2 Heraldic Beast monsters in your GY, Special Summons both of them, and immediately Xyz Summons 1 Xyz Monster using those 2 monsters only!
Charged-Up Heraldry
Sends 1 monster from your hand/field to the GY to Special Summon 2 Heraldic Beast monsters from your Deck in Defense Position.
Flash of Heraldry
Quick-Play Spell: targets 1+ monsters your opponent controls and changes their names to 'Unknown'—causing Number 69: Heraldry Crest - Dark Matter Demolition to negate all of their activated effects!
Heraldry Reborn
Special Summons 1 Heraldic Beast monster from your GY.
Augmented Heraldry
Field Spell that makes all Psychic Xyz Monsters on the field untargetable by Spells/Traps and discards a Heraldic Beast to search any 'Heraldry' Spell/Trap.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Heraldic Beast Leo from Deck to GY to search Gryphon or Stad Whale.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Augmented Heraldry.
extra: Rank 4 LIGHT Psychic Xyz: negates all other face-up Xyz Monsters on Summon, copies an Xyz Monster's name/effect, and immediately ranks up into Number 69: Heraldry Crest - Shatter Stream!

Rank 4 LIGHT Psychic Xyz (2800 ATK): Xyz Summons directly over Number 69: Heraldry Crest; when your opponent activates a monster effect or declares an attack, Special Summons Dark Matter Demolition and destroys 1 card your opponent controls!
Number 69: Heraldry Crest - Dark Matter Demolition

Rank 4 LIGHT Psychic Xyz boss (2900 ATK): cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects; detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to change an opponent's monster's name to 'Unknown', and continuously negates ALL 'Unknown' effects activated by your opponent!

Rank 4 LIGHT Psychic Xyz (2 Level 4 monsters): detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to destroy all extra copies of same-name monsters on the field, and sends ANY 2 'Heraldic Beast' monsters from your Deck to the GY when sent to the GY!
Rank 4 LIGHT Psychic Xyz: steals an opponent's Xyz Monster's name, ATK, and effect while reducing that monster's ATK to 0.
Number C69: Heraldry Crest of Horror
Rank 5 LIGHT Psychic Chaos Xyz (4000 ATK) that destroys all cards your opponent controls when an opponent's monster declares an attack.
